inv_stock_alert_subtitle: Choose which store each person monitors, plus email toggles and the default expiring-soon window.

inv_stock_alert_invalid_gap: Cooldown minutes must be at least 1.
inv_stock_alert_recipients_hint: Each row is one store and one staff member. Alerts only cover that store’s stock—match the Store column on the low-stock report. Use the Low stock / Expiring soon checkboxes per row; Policy also has separate email switches. Only hospital-assigned staff can be added.
inv_stock_alert_recipient_exists: That staff member is already listed for this store.
inv_stock_alert_select_store_staff: Select both a store and a staff member.
inv_stock_alert_cron_body: For timely alerts and email, call this endpoint on a schedule (e.g. every 15 minutes). Use email=1 only when SMTP is configured.
inv_stock_alert_cron_secret: Send header Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET> or x-cron-secret. Set CRON_SECRET in the server environment.
item_master_expiry_alert_lead_days_hint: Optional. Days before expiry to flag lots as expiring soon. Leave empty to use the hospital default from Stock alerts.
item_master_expiry_alert_lead_days_inval: Enter a whole number between 1 and 365, or leave blank.
